critical_code_review_comments: All data is hardcoded in component as expected - no API calls needed for presentation content
Good use of data-testid attributes for all 24 pages and navigation elements (ingabo-page-1 to ingabo-page-24, ingabo-prev, ingabo-next, ingabo-counter, ingabo-video)
CSS-only animations working correctly via data-active attribute trigger on .ing-page elements
Character page template (CharPage) properly handles side='left' for Gasore (page 10) and side='right' for others
Page 12 correctly uses different background color (#0A0E1A cold blue) for Keza Nkusi
Gold dust particles component (GoldDust) creates 20 animated 2px dots with drift animation
Video element on page 2 properly autoplays when page is active and pauses when inactive
Touch swipe navigation implemented for mobile
Color palette correctly applied: Dark bg #12121E, Gold #C4933F, Cyan #5DCAA5
Playfair Display serif font for headings, Inter sans-serif for body text
Page transitions use opacity crossfade (400ms) as specified
All 11 images loaded from /images/ingabo/ folder (plus 1 mp4 video)
Progress bar at bottom shows gold fill based on current page position

context_for_next_testing_agent: INGABO is a NEW 24-page cinematic presentation. Routes: /proposals/preview/ingabo (no auth, direct access), /proposals/ingabo (email gate). All data hardcoded in IngaboPresentation.jsx. Features: Gold 'INGABO' letter reveal animation on pages 1 and 24, video on page 2 with autoplay, gold dust particles (GoldDust component), character pages 9-13 with full-bleed images (CharImg component), page 12 has different bg color (#0A0E1A cold blue), CSS-only animations via data-active attribute and a-* animation classes, full keyboard/touch navigation, opacity crossfade transitions (400ms), progress bar at bottom. Color palette: Dark #12121E, Gold #C4933F, Cyan #5DCAA5, Off-white #F0EBE0. Fonts: Playfair Display serif for headings (.ing-serif), Inter sans-serif for body. Images in /app/frontend/public/images/ingabo/
